chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
No town has greater right on you than the other. The best town is that which bears you.

key_terms.حَمَلَكَ: bore you, carried you, supported you

ai.seo_question: What makes a city the best place to live according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) teaches that no specific city or region has an inherent, exclusive claim over an individual's loyalty or presence. The true merit of a place is determined by its capacity to support, sustain, and nurture the individual who resides there, reflecting the Shia emphasis on practical benefit (maslaha) over rigid geographical attachment. This principle underscores the flexibility of the faithful in seeking environments conducive to spiritual and worldly flourishing.
